questions.text: What percentage of the Read calls made by Opus 4.8 failed?

How many tool calls of any tool were rejected by input validation?
What percentage of the user's questions were followed by an edit?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND t.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND NOT t.is_sidechain)) / (SELECT count(*) FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative)

questions.text: How many Read calls failed in July 2026 (UTC)?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND r.ts >= '2026-07-01 00:00+00' AND r.ts < '2026-08-01 00:00+00'
questions.alt_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.ts >= '2026-07-01 00:00+00' AND c.ts < '2026-08-01 00:00+00'

questions.text: What percentage of all kill-by-pattern commands were run by Opus 4.8?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8') / count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (1, 2)

questions.text: How many tool calls did the agents make per typed user message, on average? Give the ratio of all tool calls to typed user messages.
questions.truth_sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_call)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0)

questions.text: How many 'stopped early' corrections did the user make while the agent ran any Opus model (all Opus versions together)?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM human_message h JOIN message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15 AND h.model LIKE 'claude-opus%'

questions.text: Of all denied tool calls, what percentage were Bash calls?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash') / count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE r.denied_mark

questions.text: How many Read calls made by subagents failed?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.is_sidechain

questions.text: How many risky shell commands of any danger pattern did the main agent run, not counting subagents?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain

questions.text: How many of the user's messages contained both an 'over-building' correction and a 'stopped early' correction?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_pattern_hit p WHERE p.msg_id = h.msg_id AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 9 AND 11) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_pattern_hit p WHERE p.msg_id = h.msg_id AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15)

questions.text: How many more Bash calls than PowerShell calls did the agents make?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE tool_name = 'Bash') - count(*) FILTER (WHERE tool_name = 'PowerShell') FROM tool_call
